carmen: Quick check30s YAML therapy a thing? My config keeps ghosting semver. :ghost:
lee: Yes. Morning sessions, bring snacks. Also bring a linter. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
ci-bot: ci-bot: \u26a0 Lint error: found mixed tabs and spaces in `service.yaml`. Please be gentle.
rachel: Found a `version: 2..0.1` today. That double-dot is clearly an ellipsis of commitment. :sweat_smile:
devops-bot: devops-bot: Heads up: deploy blocked until semver and YAML reconcile. See /playbook/semver-therapy.md.
mike: Can we have a potluck? Food + config fixes. I'll bring chili and a stash of semver stickers. :chili_pepper:
lee: Also proposing a new emoji: :yaml_heart: for indented confessions.
carmen: Example of today's heartbreak:```yaml
api:
  name: payments
  version: "v1 . 2 .3"
```
rachel: That spacing is performance art. Leave it in the gallery.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Reminder: valid semver must match /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-[a-zA-Z0-9.]+)?$/
mike: Karaoke idea: we only sing compiler errors. I call dibs on "Undefined reference to 'main'" as a chorus. :microphone:
lee: I'll bring a sticker that says "I survived a parse error and all I got was this lousy t-shirt"
carmen: Poll: potluck winners decide who writes the release notes. React with :taco: :pizza: or :sushi:. Results posted in 1h by ci-bot.
devops-bot: devops-bot: FYI lunchtime session scheduled at 12:30 in commons. Bring configs to cry on. :coffee:
rachel: kudos to @lee for fixing the deploy yesterday under 10mins. You are our semver whisperer. :tada:
lee: thanks! I accept both kudos and more snacks.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Thread locked for 2 minutes to summarize reactions.
